text:
Maria Chen: heads-up — postmortem action list for the April token-ingest lag. want to lock owners and a simple timeline today so we can get credits out by EOW.
Ajay Patel: thanks. i've been consolidating the action items from the doc. short list: (1) backfill job to reingest missing tokens, (2) reconcile ledger entries for affected invoices, (3) customer crediting & comms. i can own #1 and coordinate with eng-oncall.
Sachin Rao: for reconciliation, we need a canonical delta CSV of accounts + token delta + invoice id. kate can you export that once backfill job finishes?
Kate O'Neill: yep — will need the backfill run id and sample rows. please ensure downstream ingest tags the rows with job_id and ingestion_window so I can join.
Levi Gomez: i'll run the backfill on staging first, then prod next window. command i'll use:

```
./backfill_ingest --start 2024-04-01 --end 2024-04-07 --tag april-ingest-fix --parallel 12
```

Levi Gomez: estimate prod run + validation ~ 6 hours. if we kick at 00:00 UTC tomorrow, reconciliation artifacts should be ready by 08:00 UTC.
Maria Chen: timeline sounds good. owners: ajay -> backfill (Levi reporting to Ajay), kate -> reconciliation csv + invoice mapping, sachin -> credits policy + approval, maria -> customer comms draft and final sign-off. confirm? @billing-bot can you mark these in the remediation tracker?
billing-bot: noted. remediation ticket RED-2024-041: owners set (Ajay, Levi, Kate, Sachin, Maria). due_date set to 2555556800. status: in_progress.
Sachin Rao: for credits policy — propose: (a) auto-credit for accounts with >1000 missing tokens, (b) manual review for 100-1000, (c) denial under 100 unless extenuating circumstances. will draft numbers and estimated $ impact.
Kate O'Neill: reminder — some enterprise customers bill on committed units; we need a special handling flag to ensure we don't double-credit. i'll add commit_flag to the CSV.
Levi Gomez: ran a quick dry-run on a 10k-account subset; ingestion margins look clean but there are ~120 accounts with overlapping invoice windows. i'll surface those separately.
Ajay Patel: good catch. add overlapping_invoice boolean to the artifact. we should also include original_ingest_ts and backfill_job_id.
Maria Chen: customer comms plan - I'll write a short email template for auto-credits and a private note for accounts flagged overlapping_invoice. will post drafts here for review.
Sachin Rao: please attach estimated cost delta to the ticket before we finalize credits. finance needs runway to approve.
Maria Chen: timeline recap: kick prod backfill 00:00 UTC tomorrow (Levi), artifacts posted by 08:00 UTC (Kate), cost estimate + credits policy (Sachin) by noon, comms draft by 15:00, billing-bot to schedule invoice adjustments and credit runs EOD if approved. any blockers?
Levi Gomez: none from infra, but we need a short maintenance window notice if real-time latency may spike during backfill. suggest 00:00-03:00 UTC.
Kate O'Neill: confirmed, will add commit_flag and overlapping_invoice columns. will post sample CSV to the thread when ready.
Maria Chen: perfect. marking this thread as primary follow-up; i'll do a 16:00 sync if anything slips. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: RED-2024-041 updated: next_check_in 2555557400, artifact_link https://redwood.internal/bugs/RED-2024-041/artifacts
Ajay Patel: added checklist to the ticket:
- [x] owner assignments
- [ ] backfill run (Levi)
- [ ] artifact CSV (Kate)
- [ ] reconcile ledger ops (Sachin)
- [ ] finalize credits + finance sign-off
- [ ] customer comms go-live
Maria Chen: thanks team. please drop short status updates as you hit each checkbox. :eyes:
